title: Dutch Chickpea Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with chickpeas, vegetables, and a hint of Dutch spices. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, celery, and leek. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 8 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, tomato paste, and 2 cups of water. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
